# Compile to HTML/JS produces output file.
sngl compile --lang=js --platform=html --out=out app.sngl
stdout 'out/index.html'
exists out/index.html

# --lang without --platform is an error.
! sngl compile --lang=js app.sngl

# --platform without --lang defaults to first supported language.
sngl compile --platform=html --out=outauto app.sngl
stdout 'outauto/index.html'

# Unknown language.
! sngl compile --lang=cobol --platform=html app.sngl

# Unknown platform.
! sngl compile --lang=js --platform=dos app.sngl

# No files found.
! sngl compile --lang=js --platform=html empty/

# Parse error.
! sngl compile --lang=js --platform=html bad.sngl

# Quiet mode suppresses filename output.
sngl compile --lang=js --platform=html --out=out2 -q app.sngl
! stdout .

# Invalid output in .sngl file: lang/platform mismatch.
! sngl compile badoutput/app.sngl

# Compile a directory merges all .sngl files.
sngl compile --lang=js --platform=html --out=out3 myapp/
stdout 'out3/index.html'
exists out3/index.html

-- app.sngl --
component main {
    var count = 0
    button(text="+", @click { count += 1 })
    text(value="Count: {count}")
}
-- bad.sngl --
not valid sngl
-- empty/.gitkeep --
-- myapp/app.sngl --
component main {
    var count = 0
    Counter(initial=count)
}
-- myapp/counter.sngl --
component Counter(initial = 0) {
    text(value="Count: " + string(initial))
}
-- badoutput/app.sngl --
output go html

component main {
    text(value="hello")
}
